source_strategy: Public-web discovery across VC portfolio spotlights and investment theses, accelerator and launch platforms, startup jobs and geographic expansion reporting, company-reported usage and revenue evidence, and realized acquisition outcomes. Investor attention, founder supply, adoption, and economic durability were kept separate during discovery.

leads.raw_title: Orthogonal is building service discovery and payment rails for autonomous AI agents
leads.raw_description: Pantera Capital's July 2026 portfolio spotlight describes Orthogonal as infrastructure through which an AI agent can find a service, connect to it, and settle payment automatically. The investor says the system was already connected to more than 50 services and that Pantera led a $4.3 million seed round in June 2026.
leads.discovered_via: VC portfolio spotlight to agentic-finance thesis to named June 2026 seed investment and operating-integration claim
raw_dates: 2026-07-29 (date shown by the indexed Pantera portfolio spotlight; exact publication time not exposed)
raw_numbers: US$4.3 million seed round led by Pantera
More than 50 services Pantera says were already connected to Orthogonal
uncertainties: The integration count is investor-reported and no measurement date or methodology is stated.
The source discloses no revenue, retention, transaction volume, gross margin, or customer concentration evidence.
The spotlight's market-size forecast is third-party projection, not Orthogonal adoption evidence.

leads.raw_title: OpenFX reports rapid scale in stablecoin-based cross-border settlement
leads.raw_description: Pantera Capital's July 2026 portfolio spotlight says OpenFX replaces multi-bank cross-border routing with stablecoin settlement while keeping crypto invisible to senders and recipients. It reports that OpenFX moved its first US$1 billion in year one, reached US$1 billion per month by month 18, and had reached US$80 billion in annualized volume within two years.
leads.discovered_via: VC portfolio spotlight to always-on financial-infrastructure thesis to named portfolio company and public throughput, speed, cost, client, and financing claims
raw_dates: 2026-07-29 (date shown by the indexed Pantera portfolio spotlight; exact publication time not exposed)
2026-03 (month stated for OpenFX's Series A, outside the discovery window but included by the in-window operating update)
raw_numbers: US$80 billion annualized cross-border payment volume reported after two years
US$1 billion cumulative volume in year one
US$1 billion per month reported run rate by month 18
98% of transactions reported to settle in under one hour
90% lower reported cost than conventional cross-border settlement
US$94 million March 2026 Series A in which Pantera participated
uncertainties: All operating metrics in the spotlight are portfolio-company or investor claims without disclosed methodology.
Annualized payment volume is not revenue and does not establish profitability or retention.
The statement that OpenFX is on pace for US$1 billion per day is forward-looking rather than an achieved historical average.

leads.raw_title: Speko launches a benchmark-routed multi-provider voice stack from YC Summer 2026
leads.raw_description: Speko's founder introduced a single API that benchmarks and routes speech-to-text, language-model, and text-to-speech providers by language, region, accuracy, latency, and cost. The August 2026 Launch HN post says external usage had grown about 25% per week on average since the YC batch began in late June, with growth front-loaded toward launch weeks.
leads.discovered_via: YC Summer 2026 company profile to Launch HN founder post with product architecture, customer anecdotes, and disclosed usage-growth claim

4-person team on the YC company profile

leads.raw_title: Fypro packages TikTok audience analysis, content generation, storefronts, and owned customer lists for creators
leads.raw_description: Fypro's Product Hunt page describes a creator stack that reads a TikTok account, builds a site and niche-matched store, generates videos, and gives the creator an owned customer and email list. Product Hunt says it is trained on more than 4 million viral TikToks and used by more than 2,000 creators; Fypro's own site further labels more than 2,000 creators as active weekly and claims more than 10 million views generated last quarter.
leads.discovered_via: Product Hunt recent launch to creator-commerce business model to company landing page activity and output claims

leads.raw_title: Comp AI pairs reported ARR and customer growth with a Miami headquarters move and hiring plan
leads.raw_description: Refresh Miami reports that AI-native compliance startup Comp AI opened a permanent headquarters in Aventura after relocating from New York. Co-founder and COO Claudio Fuentes said the company grew from zero to 900 customers and to more than US$7 million ARR in 14 months; the company planned about 20 hires over 100 days and expected global headcount to grow from 23 to about 50 by year-end.

leads.raw_title: Noctrix Health closes a US$340 million strategic exit after FDA authorization and commercialization
leads.raw_description: Angelini Ventures announced that portfolio company Noctrix Health was acquired by ResMed for US$340 million, marking the venture firm's first portfolio exit. Noctrix's Nidra wearable is described as the first FDA-authorized non-invasive therapy for moderate-to-severe restless legs syndrome. ResMed's completion release says Noctrix became a wholly owned subsidiary on June 1, while contemporaneous MedTech Dive reporting put Noctrix's annual revenue run rate at about US$24 million and quoted ResMed management saying its revenue growth and gross margin exceeded ResMed's.
leads.discovered_via: Venture portfolio exit announcement to acquirer completion release and contemporaneous operating-economics reporting
leads.market: United States and global sleep-health market
raw_dates: 2024 (Angelini Ventures investment year stated in the release)
2016 (Noctrix founding year stated in the release)

uncertainties: The acquisition value is not a revenue or profit metric and includes strategic value to the acquirer.
The approximately US$24 million revenue run rate is reported secondhand; the underlying period and revenue definition are not disclosed in the inspected source excerpt.
Higher growth and gross margin are comparative management statements without absolute percentages.
No patient retention, reimbursement mix, unit economics, or post-acquisition operating result is published.
